stem: Which statement about debit cards and credit cards is NOT true?

options.label: A
options.text: Interest is charged on debit card purchases.

options.label: B
options.text: When a debit card is used for purchases, money is withdrawn directly from a bank account.

options.label: C
options.text: The total amount of money that can be spent on credit card purchases depends on a customer's credit limit.

options.label: D
options.text: When a credit card is used, money is borrowed.
